source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: At [Dark Pact](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.dark-pacts) activation, measure the distance to the Helbrute. A **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit on your side qualifies from up to 6″ away. Give both pact abilities to the weapons its models carry, through phase end.

effect.recipient: weapons equipped by eligible unit models
effect.darkPactAbilities: both in place of choosing one
